tasks.check: deno task format:check && deno task lint:check && deno task type:check
tasks.type:check: deno check mod.ts cli.ts clients/*.ts examples/*.ts
tasks.test: deno test -A --doc --coverage mod.ts lib clients tests
tasks.test:all: deno task db:start && deno task test; status=$?; deno task db:stop; exit $status
tasks.docker: sh -c 'if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker "$@"; elif command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman "$@"; else echo "ERROR: neither docker nor podman found" >&2; exit 1; fi' --
tasks.db:start: deno task docker compose -f tests/compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans --wait
tasks.db:stop: deno task docker compose -f tests/compose.yml down --remove-orphans --volumes
